nodes.label: Community Health Worker

properties.title: Community Health Worker
properties.name: CommunityHealthWorker
properties.description:
A frontline member of the health workforce who delivers health interventions
at the community level, acting as a link between communities and formal health
facilities. Community health workers are a key sub-group of healthcare providers.

Community health workers use DHIs to:
- Register and follow-up community members (2.1, 2.2.1)
- Receive community-based decision support and job aids (2.3)
- Report public health events from point of diagnosis (3.3.1)
- Access mobile training and competency assessments (2.8)
- Communicate with supervising clinical staff (2.5.1)
- Manage their daily visit planning and activities (2.7)

**ISCO-08**: 3255 (Community health workers), 5321 (Health care assistants).

**Examples**: Village health worker, health extension worker, community health
volunteer, lay health advisor, peer educator, traditional birth attendant,
community case manager.

nodes.label: Health Data Manager and Analyst

properties.title: Health Data Manager and Analyst
properties.name: DataManager
properties.description:
A professional who manages, analyses, and disseminates health data to support
evidence-based decision-making. This corresponds to the 'Data services' user
group in CDISAH v2, providing crosscutting functionality across the health system.

Data managers use DHIs to:
- Create data collection forms and manage data acquisition (4.1.1)
- Store and aggregate health data (4.1.2)
- Synthesise and visualise data for reporting and dashboards (4.1.3)
- Apply automated analytics and predictive modelling including AI/ML (4.1.4)
- Parse, de-duplicate, and curate coded datasets and terminologies (4.2)
- Classify disease codes and causes of mortality (4.2.3)
- Map geographic locations of facilities, events, populations, and providers (4.3)
- Enable point-to-point data integration and standards-compliant interoperability (4.4)
- Maintain data governance including authentication, privacy, and consent (4.5)

**ISCO-08**: 2120 (Mathematicians, actuaries and statisticians), 2521 (Database
designers and administrators), 2523 (Computer network professionals), 3120
(Computer network and systems technicians).

**Examples**: Biostatistician, epidemiologist, health informatician, data analyst,
DHIS2 administrator, GIS specialist, interoperability engineer, terminology manager.

nodes.label: Health System Manager

properties.title: Health System Manager
properties.name: HealthSystemManager
properties.description:
A professional involved in the administration and oversight of health systems.

Health system managers use DHIs to:
- Manage health workforce information, performance, and certification (3.1)
- Oversee supply chain, inventory, cold chain, and procurement (3.2)
- Receive notifications of public health events (3.3)
- Register and certify vital events — births and deaths (3.4)
- Administer health coverage schemes, billing, payroll, and budgets (3.5)
- Monitor and track health equipment and assets (3.6)
- Manage health facility information and conduct assessments (3.7)
- Manage person-centred health certificate information (3.8)

**ISCO-08**: 1342 (Health services managers), 2446 (Social work professionals
n.e.c.), 3354 (Government social benefits officials), 4311 (Accounting and
bookkeeping clerks).

**Examples**: District health officer, programme manager, supply chain officer,
HMIS coordinator, hospital administrator, vital registration officer,
health insurance administrator.

nodes.label: Healthcare Provider

properties.title: Healthcare Provider
properties.name: HealthcareProvider
properties.description:
A member of the health workforce who delivers health interventions. This group
has also been described as 'health workers' or 'healthcare workers'.

Healthcare providers use DHIs to:
- Identify and register persons for health services (2.1)
- Manage person-centred health records (2.2)
- Receive clinical decision support prompts and checklists (2.3)
- Conduct telemedicine consultations and remote monitoring (2.4)
- Communicate with supervisors, peers, and receive AI-assisted content (2.5)
- Coordinate referrals and emergency transport (2.6)
- Schedule and plan their clinical activities (2.7)
- Access training content and assessments (2.8)
- Manage prescriptions and medication adherence (2.9)
- Order and receive laboratory and diagnostic results (2.10)
- Verify health coverage and receive payments from individuals (2.11)

**ISCO-08**: 2211 (Generalist medical practitioners), 2212 (Specialist medical
practitioners), 2221 (Nursing professionals), 2222 (Midwifery professionals),
3211 (Medical imaging and therapeutic equipment technicians), 3212 (Medical
and pathology laboratory technicians), 3213 (Pharmaceutical technicians and
assistants), 3221 (Nursing associate professionals), 3222 (Midwifery associate
professionals), 3255 (Community health workers).

**Examples**: Physician, nurse, midwife, clinical officer, pharmacist,
laboratory technician, dentist, allied health professional.

properties.title: Person (Health Service User)
properties.name: Person
properties.description:
A member of the public who is a potential or current user of health services,
including health prevention and wellness activities. Other terms used for this
group include 'patient', 'client', 'individual', and 'health service user'.
Caregivers of individuals receiving health services are also included.

Persons interact with DHIs to:
- Receive targeted (1.1) and untargeted (1.2) health communications
- Communicate with other persons as peers (1.3)
- Track their own health data and records (1.4)
- Report health events and system feedback (1.5)
- Access health information on demand including via chatbot/AI (1.6)
- Manage their financial transactions related to health services (1.7)
- Manage their consent for health data access and sharing (1.8)

**ISCO-08**: Not applicable (non-occupational role).

**Examples**: Patient, pregnant woman, caregiver, child, community member,
health scheme beneficiary, person living with a chronic condition.

properties.title: Client Registry / Master Patient Index
properties.name: ClientRegistry
properties.description:
A digital system that creates, maintains, and provides authoritative unique
identifiers for individuals (persons) accessing health services, enabling
cross-facility patient matching and de-duplication.

The client registry supports DHIs including:
- Verify a person's unique identity (2.1.1)
- Enrol person(s) for health services/clinical care plan (2.1.2)
- Merge, de-duplicate and curate coded datasets (4.2.2)
- Standards-compliant interoperability to link records across systems (4.4.2)

**Services and Application Types**:
- C6 — Identification registries and directories
- C8 — Master patient index

properties.title: Electronic Medical Record (EMR) System
properties.name: ElectronicMedicalRecord
properties.description:
A secure, digital system that holds information about people's health and
clinical care managed by healthcare providers. Also referred to as an
Electronic Health Record (EHR).

The EMR system supports DHIs including:
- Longitudinal tracking of person's health status and services (2.2.1)
- Management of structured clinical records (2.2.2)
- Management of unstructured clinical records such as notes and images (2.2.3)
- Clinical decision support prompts and checklists (2.3)
- Person identification and registration (2.1)
- Prescription and medication management (2.9)
- Laboratory results reception (2.10.1)
- Routine health indicator data collection (2.2.4)

**Services and Application Type**: A5 — Electronic medical record systems

**Functional areas**: Clinical decision support, record management,
person registration, appointment scheduling, referral tracking.

properties.title: Health Management Information System (HMIS)
properties.name: HealthManagementInformationSystem
properties.description:
A digital system used to collect, process, report, and use aggregate health data
for programme planning, monitoring, and evaluation at district and national levels.

The HMIS supports DHIs including:
- Routine health indicator data collection and management (2.2.4)
- Non-routine data collection and management (4.1.1)
- Data storage and aggregation (4.1.2)
- Data synthesis and visualisations (4.1.3)
- Data exchange across systems (4.4)

**Services and Application Type**: D6 — Health Management Information Systems (HMIS)

**Functional areas**: Data collection, reporting dashboards, target monitoring,
programme performance tracking, data quality management.

properties.title: Health Information Exchange / Interoperability Platform
properties.name: InteroperabilityPlatform
properties.description:
A middleware system or shared infrastructure that enables health data exchange
between disparate health information systems using standard protocols and formats.

The interoperability platform supports DHIs including:
- Point-to-point data integration (4.4.1)
- Standards-compliant interoperability (4.4.2)
- Message routing to appropriate architecture components (4.4.3)
- Data storage and aggregation across systems (4.1.2)

**Services and Application Type**: D2 — Data interchange and interoperability

**Functional areas**: Semantic interoperability, technical interoperability,
information exchange, data mediation, enterprise service bus.

properties.title: Laboratory Information System (LIS)
properties.name: LaboratoryInformationSystem
properties.description:
A digital system that manages the complete lifecycle of laboratory test orders,
specimen tracking, result production, and result reporting to healthcare providers
and persons.

The LIS supports DHIs including:
- Transmit and track diagnostic orders (2.10.2)
- Capture diagnostic results from digital devices (2.10.3)
- Transmit person's diagnostic result to healthcare provider (2.10.1)
- Transmit diagnostics result or availability of result to person(s) (1.1.4)
- Track biological specimens (2.10.4)

**Services and Application Type**: A6 — Laboratory information systems

**Functional areas**: Lab requests/test ordering, sample tracking, sample
processing, results reporting.

properties.title: Logistics Management Information System (LMIS)
properties.name: LogisticsManagementInformationSystem
properties.description:
A digital system that manages the health supply chain from quantification
and forecasting through distribution, inventory management, and consumption tracking.

The LMIS supports DHIs including:
- Manage inventory and distribution of health commodities (3.2.1)
- Notify stock levels of health commodities (3.2.2)
- Monitor cold-chain sensitive commodities (3.2.3)
- Register licensed drugs and health commodities (3.2.4)
- Manage procurement of commodities (3.2.5)

**Services and Application Type**: B6 — Logistics management information systems (LMIS)

nodes.label: Public Health and Disease Surveillance System

properties.title: Public Health and Disease Surveillance System
properties.name: PublicHealthSurveillanceSystem
properties.description:
A digital system for detecting, monitoring, investigating, and responding to
disease outbreaks and public health threats.

The surveillance system supports DHIs including:
- Notification of public health events from point of diagnosis (3.3.1)
- Transmit health event alerts to specific population group(s) (1.1.1)
- Map location of health event (4.3.2)
- Data synthesis and visualizations for outbreak response (4.1.3)
- Automated analysis of data to generate predictions (4.1.4)

**Services and Application Type**: E2 — Public health and disease surveillance systems

properties.title: Business Analyst
properties.name: BusinessAnalyst
properties.description:
A digital health informatician specializing in business analysis who authors
L2 DAK components. Business analysts translate clinical guidelines and
normative products into structured DAK artifacts including business processes,
data dictionaries, decision-support logic, and requirements.

Key activities:
- Review L1 source documents and extract structured content
- Author generic personas based on task-shifting guidelines
- Create user scenario narratives
- Design BPMN 2.0 business process diagrams
- Define core data elements and data dictionary
- Develop decision-support logic tables (DMN standard)
- Develop scheduling logic tables
- Define indicators and performance metrics
- Capture functional and non-functional requirements
- Streamline content across DAK components for consistency

**Source**: IG Starter Kit, L2 DAK Authoring, Section 2.1 "Fill in DAK components";
Community of Practice page

properties.title: Clinical Subject Matter Expert
properties.name: ClinicalSME
properties.description:
A clinician or subject matter expert (SME) of a specific health area who
validates the clinical accuracy and completeness of DAK content against
WHO guidelines and other normative products. SMEs should be the authors
of the source documents or recognized experts actively engaged in, if not
leading, the collaborative development of the DAKs.

Key activities:
- Validate that DAK components accurately reflect L1 recommendations
- Provide clinical ground-truthing through country visits and interviews
- Identify gaps or needed changes in DAK content
- Review decision-support logic for clinical correctness
- Confirm that workflows represent 80% of clinical scenarios
- Validate personas against real-world practice settings
- Advise on cross-programme overlaps (e.g. TB/HIV indicators)

**Source**: IG Starter Kit, L2 DAK Authoring, Sections 1 "Plan" and 2.2 "Validate"

properties.title: Content Reviewer / Approver
properties.name: ContentReviewer
properties.description:
A designated reviewer responsible for approving SMART Guidelines content
at key decision gates in the authoring lifecycle. Content Reviewers ensure
that DAK and IG content meets quality standards, accurately reflects WHO
normative guidance, and is ready to proceed to the next phase.

Content Reviewers may be senior technical officers, programme leads, or
designated governance committee members. They provide formal sign-off at
phase transitions (L2→L3, draft→publication).

Key activities:
- Review and approve L2 DAK content before L3 authoring begins
- Review and approve L3 IG content before publication
- Assess whether content changes are breaking or non-breaking
- Approve draft publications for stakeholder circulation
- Provide final sign-off for release publication
- Ensure content aligns with WHO guidelines governance policies
- Participate in cross-programme content harmonization reviews

**Source**: IG Starter Kit, Publication page (review process);
DAK Authoring, Section 2.2 "Validate DAK content with SMEs"

properties.title: FHIR Modeller
properties.name: FHIRModeller
properties.description:
An L3 author who creates machine-readable FHIR artifacts from L2 DAK
specifications. FHIR Modellers use FSH (FHIR Shorthand), SUSHI, and
the IG Publisher toolchain to produce conformant Implementation Guides.

Key activities:
- Verify L2 input availability and consistency
- Author FHIR Logical Models from L2 data dictionaries
- Create FHIR Profiles (StructureDefinitions)
- Author FHIR Questionnaires from L2 forms
- Write CQL for decision logic, scheduling logic, and indicators
- Create StructureMaps for data extraction
- Author PlanDefinitions for business processes and decision tables
- Create ActorDefinitions from L2 personas (reusing Commons repository)
- Create ExampleScenario resources from L2 user scenarios
- Author FHIR Measure resources from L2 indicators
- Create FHIR Requirements resources
- Develop test cases (TestPlan, TestScript, example instances)
- Ensure all artifacts conform to CRMI Shareable/Publishable profiles

**Source**: IG Starter Kit, L2-L3 Overview and all L3 authoring pages

properties.title: Programme Manager
properties.name: ProgrammeManager
properties.description:
A programme manager responsible for the overall coordination and management
of the Digital Adaptation Kit (DAK) development process. Programme managers
lead scoping, resource allocation, timeline planning, and stakeholder engagement.

The DAK development team should be small (<10 people) and nimble. The Programme
Manager ensures the team is empowered to self-organize and manage DAK-related
work including collaboration with stakeholders, content development, validation,
and publication.

Key activities:
- Define DAK scope and purpose
- Form and coordinate the DAK development team
- Establish development process and governance
- Define RASCI matrix for roles and responsibilities
- Plan sprint iterations and maintain the DAK backlog
- Coordinate SME consultations (workshops, country visits)
- Draft project roadmap with milestone dates
- Assess and secure resources and budget

**Source**: IG Starter Kit, L2 DAK Authoring, Section 1 "Plan"

properties.title: Publication Manager
properties.name: PublicationManager
properties.description:
A specialist responsible for managing the FHIR Implementation Guide
configuration, build process, versioning, and release publication workflow.
Publication Managers ensure IGs are correctly configured, built, and
published to smart.who.int following the established publication process.

Key activities:
- Set up IG repositories from smart-ig-empty template
- Configure sushi-config.yaml (canonical URL, package ID, dependencies)
- Enable GitHub Pages and CI build workflows
- Run FHIR IG Publisher builds and verify output
- Manage semantic versioning (major.minor.patch)
- Create publication-request.json for releases
- Create release branches, tags, and GitHub releases
- Monitor automated publication workflows
- Coordinate with WHO SMART Guidelines team for smart.who.int updates
- Manage cross-IG governance for shared artifacts
- Reset main branch to draft status after publication

**Source**: IG Starter Kit, IG Setup, IG Publication, and IG Configuration pages

properties.title: Quality Control Reviewer
properties.name: QCReviewer
properties.description:
A quality assurance specialist responsible for reviewing SMART Guidelines
Implementation Guides for publication readiness. QC Reviewers use the
publication checklist across L1-L4 layers, interpret QA validation reports,
and verify artifact conformance and cross-component consistency.

Key activities:
- Run and interpret IG Publisher QA reports (qa.html)
- Review publication checklist across L1, L2, L3, L4, and Global sections
- Verify conformance to Shareable, Publishable, Computable, Executable profiles
- Validate StructureMap extraction produces expected output
- Verify CQL execution and measure calculations
- Check cross-component consistency (personas, data elements, processes)
- Validate all artifacts have required title, description, and mappings
- Confirm naming conventions and reference resolution
- Review change log completeness and versioning compliance

**Source**: IG Starter Kit, QA Check page, Checklist page, Validating IG page

properties.title: Technical Officer
properties.name: TechnicalOfficer
properties.description:
A health area technical officer who coordinates the work on the DAK and
performs first-pass review and validation of DAK content. Technical officers
are part of the DAK development team and serve as the primary bridge between
the development team and the broader group of Subject Matter Experts.

Key activities:
- Coordinate DAK development work within the health programme area
- Perform first-pass review of drafted DAK components
- Validate that components accurately reflect L1 recommendations
- Identify gaps, ambiguities, and alternatives in DAK content
- Prepare agendas and questions for SME consultation meetings
- Ensure content is software-neutral and context-appropriate
- Spread awareness of SMART Guidelines within the department

**Source**: IG Starter Kit, L2 DAK Authoring, Section 2.2 "Validate DAK content with SMEs"

properties.title: Terminologist
properties.name: Terminologist
properties.description:
A specialist responsible for ensuring semantic interoperability of SMART
Guidelines through proper terminology management. Terminologists manage
the WHO Commons dictionary, concept mappings, and ensure every data element
is mapped to approved standard terminologies.

Key activities:
- Map data elements to WHO Commons dictionary concepts
- Create and maintain CodeSystem resources
- Create and maintain ValueSet resources
- Create ConceptMap resources for cross-terminology mappings
- Map to ICD-11, SNOMED CT, LOINC, IPS, and WHO FIC
- Onboard new concepts into the Commons dictionary
- Verify no duplicate or overlapping concept definitions
- Review terminology bindings in logical models and profiles
- Flag unapproved concepts as QA issues before publication

**Source**: IG Starter Kit, Governance Concepts page;
L3 authoring pages for CodeSystems, ValueSets, ConceptMaps

properties.title: Translator
properties.name: Translator
properties.description:
A language specialist responsible for translating SMART Guidelines
Implementation Guide content across UN languages to support global
adoption and adaptation.

Key activities:
- Translate IG narrative content across UN languages
- Translate FHIR resource display names and descriptions
- Review translated content for accuracy and clinical correctness
- Manage .pot/.po translation template files
- Coordinate with clinical SMEs for domain-specific terminology
- Ensure translated examples are available for each non-abstract profile

**Source**: IG Starter Kit, Checklist L4 (example resources per UN language);
PR 288 translation skill infrastructure

properties.benefit: DAK content is accurate, consistent, and faithfully represents WHO clinical recommendations

properties.label: Verify L1 accuracy
properties.requirement: Can verify that DAK components accurately reflect L1 recommendations.

properties.label: Identify gaps and changes
properties.requirement: Can identify gaps, key changes, and alternatives in DAK content.

properties.label: Verify software neutrality
properties.requirement: Can verify that DAK components are software-neutral and do not assume any specific software or device.

properties.label: Streamline cross-component consistency
properties.requirement: Can review DAK for cross-component consistency: persona naming, data element usage, workflow alignment, and requirement linkage.

properties.label: Incorporate SME feedback
properties.requirement: Can analyse feedback from SMEs, identify patterns, incorporate changes, and confirm accurate reflection of suggestions.

properties.title: Can author logical models
properties.description: Capability to create FHIR logical models (StructureDefinitions) from L2 data dictionaries.
properties.capability: create FHIR logical models from L2 data dictionaries
properties.benefit: data elements are formally modelled and mapped to standard terminologies for interoperability

properties.label: Create StructureDefinition from data dictionary
properties.requirement: Can create a FHIR StructureDefinition (kind: logical) for each core data set from the L2 data dictionary.

properties.label: Map elements to WHO Commons
properties.requirement: Can ensure every data element in the logical model is mapped to a WHO Commons concept in the WHO Common dictionary.

properties.label: Add standard terminology mappings
properties.requirement: Can add mappings to LOINC, SNOMED, ICD-11, and other standard terminologies on logical model elements.

properties.label: Write FSH for logical models
properties.requirement: Can author logical models using FHIR Shorthand (FSH) syntax.

properties.title: Can author FHIR profiles
properties.description: Capability to create FHIR profiles (StructureDefinitions) constraining base FHIR resources.
properties.capability: create FHIR profiles constraining base FHIR resources
properties.benefit: resource structures are constrained and validated for DAK-specific use cases

properties.label: Create resource profiles
properties.requirement: Can create FHIR StructureDefinition profiles that constrain base FHIR resources for DAK use cases.

properties.label: Apply CRMI conformance profiles
properties.requirement: Can ensure profiles conform to CRMI Shareable, Publishable, Computable, and Executable profiles as appropriate.

properties.label: Bind terminology
properties.requirement: Can add appropriate terminology bindings (required, extensible, preferred) to profile elements.

properties.label: Write FSH for profiles
properties.requirement: Can author profiles using FHIR Shorthand (FSH) syntax.

properties.title: Can author questionnaires
properties.description: Capability to create FHIR Questionnaire resources aligned with L2 forms and data collection needs.
properties.capability: create FHIR Questionnaire resources aligned with L2 data collection forms
properties.benefit: data collection instruments are standardized and linked to the logical model

properties.label: Create FHIR Questionnaires
properties.requirement: Can create FHIR Questionnaire resources aligned with L2 data collection forms and workflow activities.

properties.label: Conform to SDC profiles
properties.requirement: Can ensure questionnaires conform to SDC (Structured Data Capture) profiles.

properties.label: Link to logical models
properties.requirement: Can link questionnaire items to corresponding logical model data elements.

properties.title: Can author CQL
properties.description: Capability to write Clinical Quality Language (CQL) for decision logic, scheduling logic, and indicator calculations.
properties.capability: write CQL for decision logic, scheduling logic, and indicator calculations
properties.benefit: clinical decision-support and indicator calculations are computable and testable

properties.label: Write CQL decision logic
properties.requirement: Can write CQL libraries implementing L2 decision-support logic tables.

properties.label: Write CQL scheduling logic
properties.requirement: Can write CQL libraries implementing L2 scheduling logic tables.

properties.label: Write CQL indicator logic
properties.requirement: Can write CQL libraries implementing indicator calculations with numerator/denominator definitions.

properties.label: Create CQL concept definitions
properties.requirement: Can create CQL concept and data element definitions for use across libraries.

properties.label: Test CQL execution
properties.requirement: Can validate CQL execution against test data using reference tooling.

properties.title: Can author structure maps
properties.description: Capability to create FHIR StructureMaps for data extraction from QuestionnaireResponses to FHIR resources.
properties.capability: create FHIR StructureMaps for data extraction from QuestionnaireResponses
properties.benefit: questionnaire data is automatically extracted into structured FHIR resources

properties.label: Create StructureMaps
properties.requirement: Can create FHIR StructureMaps for extracting data from QuestionnaireResponses into FHIR resources.

properties.label: Map to IPS
properties.requirement: Can create StructureMaps mapping logical models to the International Patient Summary (IPS) data set.

properties.label: Validate extraction output
properties.requirement: Can validate that StructureMap extraction produces exactly the expected output using reference tooling.

properties.title: Can author plan definitions
properties.description: Capability to create FHIR PlanDefinitions for business processes and decision tables.
properties.capability: create FHIR PlanDefinitions for business processes and decision tables
properties.benefit: business processes and decision logic are formally represented as executable FHIR resources

properties.label: Create business process PlanDefinitions
properties.requirement: Can create FHIR PlanDefinitions of type workflow-definition for each L2 business process.

properties.label: Define actions and participants
properties.requirement: Can define action elements with title, description, participant (persona), and relatedAction (flow) for each process node.

properties.label: Conform to CRMI profiles
properties.requirement: Can ensure PlanDefinitions conform to CRMIShareablePlanDefinition and CRMIPublishablePlanDefinition profiles.

properties.label: Create decision table PlanDefinitions
properties.requirement: Can create FHIR PlanDefinitions implementing L2 decision tables with associated CQL libraries.

properties.title: Can author actor definitions
properties.description: Capability to create FHIR ActorDefinitions from L2 personas, reusing existing definitions from the Commons repository.
properties.capability: create FHIR ActorDefinitions from L2 personas
properties.benefit: personas are formally defined as reusable FHIR resources across SMART Guidelines IGs

properties.label: Reuse Commons personas
properties.requirement: Can check the Commons repository for existing ActorDefinitions and reuse them when adequate.

properties.label: Create new ActorDefinitions
properties.requirement: Can create draft ActorDefinitions with appropriate name, title, description, and type when no existing persona fits.

properties.label: Submit for governance approval
properties.requirement: Can submit new persona definitions to the Commons governance process for approval before final publication.

properties.label: Write FSH for ActorDefinitions
properties.requirement: Can author ActorDefinition instances using FHIR Shorthand (FSH) syntax.

properties.title: Can author example scenarios
properties.description: Capability to create ExampleScenario resources from L2 user scenarios.
properties.capability: create ExampleScenario resources from L2 user scenarios
properties.benefit: user scenarios are formally represented and linked to actors and business processes

properties.label: Create ExampleScenario resources
properties.requirement: Can create FHIR ExampleScenario resources that formalize L2 user scenarios.

properties.label: Link to actors and processes
properties.requirement: Can link ExampleScenarios to corresponding ActorDefinitions and PlanDefinitions.

properties.title: Can author measures
properties.description: Capability to create FHIR Measure resources from L2 indicators.
properties.capability: create FHIR Measure resources from L2 indicators
properties.benefit: indicator calculations are computable and aligned with the Data Sharing Specification

properties.label: Create Measure resources
properties.requirement: Can create FHIR Measure resources with population criteria referencing CQL indicator logic.

properties.label: Define numerator and denominator
properties.requirement: Can define numerator and denominator populations using CQL expressions.

properties.label: Apply DSS specification
properties.requirement: Can define measures according to the Data Sharing Specification (DSS) described in the IHE White Paper for mADX.

properties.title: Can author FHIR requirements
properties.description: Capability to create FHIR Requirements resources from L2 functional and non-functional requirements.
properties.capability: create FHIR Requirements resources from L2 functional and non-functional requirements
properties.benefit: requirements are formally tracked as FHIR resources with traceability to actors and processes

properties.label: Create Requirements resources
properties.requirement: Can create FHIR Requirements resources representing L2 functional and non-functional requirements.

properties.label: Define requirement statements
properties.requirement: Can define requirement statements with key, label, conformance level, and requirement text.

properties.label: Link to actors
properties.requirement: Can link Requirements resources to the appropriate ActorDefinitions.

properties.title: Can author test cases
properties.description: Capability to create TestPlan, TestScript, and example instances for validation of L3 artifacts.
properties.capability: create TestPlan, TestScript, and example instances for validation
properties.benefit: L3 artifacts are validated against defined acceptance criteria with reproducible tests

properties.label: Create TestPlan resources
properties.requirement: Can create FHIR TestPlan resources defining test scope and acceptance criteria.

properties.label: Create TestScript resources
properties.requirement: Can create FHIR TestScript resources for automated validation.

properties.label: Create example instances
properties.requirement: Can create example resource instances for each non-abstract profile in each UN language.

properties.label: Create test data
properties.requirement: Can create test data or Synthea scripts for validating CQL execution and measure calculation.

properties.title: Can scope DAK
properties.description: Capability to define DAK scope, identify source documents, and establish the development process and governance.
properties.capability: define DAK scope, identify source documents, and establish governance
properties.benefit: DAK development is well-scoped with clear ownership, tooling, and resource allocation

properties.label: Define DAK purpose and target audience
properties.requirement: Can articulate the purpose of the DAK, identify the target audience, assess whether similar publications exist, and define the gaps the DAK will address.

properties.label: Establish development process
properties.requirement: Can establish the development process and governance to be used, including selection of agile methodology and determination of ownership and key stakeholders.

properties.label: Determine project tooling
properties.requirement: Can determine the tools to be used for project tracking, communication, and DAK components design (e.g. BPMN tooling).

properties.label: Assess resource requirements
properties.requirement: Can assess the necessary resources to develop the DAK, including securing adequate budget for each step of the process.

properties.label: Gather source documents
properties.requirement: Can gather and catalogue source documents including normative products, policy documents, paper registers, tally sheets, and reporting tools.

properties.title: Can configure IG
properties.description: Capability to set up and configure a FHIR Implementation Guide (sushi-config, canonical URL, packages).
properties.capability: set up and configure a FHIR Implementation Guide
properties.benefit: IG repositories are correctly configured for building, publishing, and national adaptation

properties.label: Fork IG template
properties.requirement: Can fork the smart-ig-empty template repository using 'Use this Template' with 'Include all branches' to ensure gh-pages branch is cloned.

properties.label: Configure sushi-config.yaml
properties.requirement: Can configure sushi-config.yaml with correct canonical URL (https://smart.who.int/<ig_code>), package ID (smart.who.int.<ig_code>), and dependencies.

properties.label: Enable GitHub Pages
properties.requirement: Can enable GitHub Pages from the gh-pages branch and confirm repo allows GitHub Actions read/write access.

properties.label: Configure for national adaptations
properties.requirement: Can configure package IDs for national adaptations following HL7 affiliate conventions (hl7.fhir.country.smart.<ig_code>).

properties.title: Can build IG
properties.description: Capability to run the FHIR IG Publisher build process and verify output.
properties.capability: run the FHIR IG Publisher build process and verify output
properties.benefit: IG builds are verified locally and on CI before publication

properties.label: Run IG Publisher locally
properties.requirement: Can run the FHIR IG Publisher build process locally and interpret build output.

properties.label: Verify GitHub Pages build
properties.requirement: Can verify CI builds on GitHub Pages (org.github.io/repo for default branch, /branches/branch_name for other branches).

properties.label: Verify FHIR build
properties.requirement: Can verify builds on build.fhir.org/ig/ for tooling and registry recognition.

properties.label: Interpret build errors
properties.requirement: Can interpret IG Publisher build errors and resolve common issues (missing dependencies, invalid references, SUSHI errors).

properties.title: Can manage releases
properties.description: Capability to manage versioning, publication-request.json, release tags, and publication workflow.
properties.capability: manage versioning, release tags, and the publication workflow
properties.benefit: IG releases follow semantic versioning and are published through a governed, repeatable process

properties.label: Determine version number
properties.requirement: Can review changes since last release, determine if changes are breaking, and update version number following semantic versioning.

properties.label: Update IG status for release
properties.requirement: Can update IG and all conformance artifacts: status to active, version without label, releaseLabel to release, and date to current date.

properties.label: Create publication-request.json
properties.requirement: Can create a correct publication-request.json with matching package-id, version, path, ci-build, and first/subsequent flags.

properties.label: Create release tag
properties.requirement: Can create a GitHub release and tag in the form vX.Y.Z to trigger the automated publication workflow.

properties.label: Verify publication
properties.requirement: Can verify the publication workflow succeeded and the IG is available at the sitepreview URL.

properties.label: Reset to draft
properties.requirement: Can reset the main branch to draft status with updated version number after publication.

properties.label: Maintain change log
properties.requirement: Can maintain a changes page with release summary, known issues, and categorized changes (non-compatible, compatible substantive, non-substantive).

properties.title: Can manage governance
properties.description: Capability to manage cross-IG governance for shared artifacts including common personas, terminology, and libraries.
properties.capability: manage cross-IG governance for shared artifacts
properties.benefit: shared artifacts are consistently governed and reused across SMART Guidelines IGs

properties.label: Manage shared artifact lifecycle
properties.requirement: Can manage the lifecycle of shared artifacts (common personas, terminology, CQL libraries) across multiple SMART Guidelines IGs.

properties.label: Coordinate concept approval
properties.requirement: Can coordinate the approval process for new concepts being onboarded into the WHO Commons dictionary.

properties.label: Track cross-IG dependencies
properties.requirement: Can track and manage dependencies between IGs and shared artifact repositories.

properties.label: Coordinate smart.who.int updates
properties.requirement: Can coordinate with the WHO SMART Guidelines team (smart@who.int) for website updates and package list pull requests.

properties.title: Can run QA checks
properties.description: Capability to run and interpret IG Publisher QA validation reports.
properties.capability: run and interpret IG Publisher QA validation reports
properties.benefit: IG quality issues are identified and resolved before publication

properties.label: Run IG Publisher QA
properties.requirement: Can run the FHIR IG Publisher and locate the generated qa.html report.

properties.label: Interpret QA errors and warnings
properties.requirement: Can interpret QA validation errors, warnings, and information messages to identify issues requiring resolution.

properties.label: Triage suppressions
properties.requirement: Can assess whether warnings can be legitimately suppressed with reasonable explanation, and document suppressions.

properties.label: Verify zero-error status
properties.requirement: Can verify that the QA report shows no errors or unsuppressed warnings before publication.

properties.title: Can review checklist
properties.description: Capability to review the SMART Guidelines publication checklist across L1-L4 layers and global requirements.
properties.capability: review the SMART Guidelines publication checklist across L1-L4 layers
properties.benefit: all publication requirements are systematically verified before release

properties.label: Review L1 checklist
properties.requirement: Can verify L1 checklist items: home page summary, providing feedback section, and adapting guidelines page.

properties.label: Review L2 checklist
properties.requirement: Can verify L2 checklist items: concepts, personas, use cases, business processes, data dictionary, decision-support, indicators, and requirements pages.

properties.label: Review L3 checklist
properties.requirement: Can verify L3 checklist items: system actors, sequence diagrams, transactions, logical models, indicators/measures, mappings, and artifact profile conformance.

properties.label: Review L4 checklist
properties.requirement: Can verify L4 checklist items: example data per UN language, test definitions, test data, reference implementations, and downloads.

properties.label: Review global checklist
properties.requirement: Can verify global checklist items: maturity level, versioning policy, HL7 publishing requirements, QA report, and changes page.

properties.title: Can validate artifact conformance
properties.description: Capability to verify conformance to CRMI Shareable, Publishable, Computable, and Executable profiles.
properties.capability: verify conformance to CRMI Shareable, Publishable, Computable, and Executable profiles
properties.benefit: all artifacts meet the required conformance levels for interoperability and publication

properties.label: Check Shareable conformance
properties.requirement: Can verify artifacts conform to CRMIShareable profiles (name, title, description, status).

properties.label: Check Publishable conformance
properties.requirement: Can verify active published artifacts conform to CRMIPublishable profiles.

properties.label: Check Computable conformance
properties.requirement: Can verify artifacts conform to CRMIComputable profiles where applicable.

properties.label: Check Executable conformance
properties.requirement: Can verify ValueSet and Library artifacts conform to CRMIExecutable profiles.

properties.title: Can validate L3 functionality
properties.description: Capability to test StructureMap extraction, CQL execution, and measure calculation using reference tooling.
properties.capability: test StructureMap extraction, CQL execution, and measure calculation
properties.benefit: L3 artifacts produce correct, verified results before publication

properties.label: Test StructureMap extraction
properties.requirement: Can execute StructureMaps against test QuestionnaireResponses and verify extracted resources match expected output.

properties.label: Test CQL execution
properties.requirement: Can execute CQL libraries against test data and verify decision logic, scheduling logic, and indicator calculations.

properties.label: Test measure calculation
properties.requirement: Can execute FHIR Measure evaluations and verify numerator/denominator calculations against expected results.

properties.label: Verify L2 content coverage
properties.requirement: Can manually verify that all L2 specifications are covered by corresponding L3 artifacts.

properties.title: Can manage stakeholders
properties.description: Capability to engage SMEs, coordinate consultations, and manage the RASCI matrix for DAK development.
properties.capability: engage SMEs, coordinate consultations, and manage the RASCI matrix
properties.benefit: all stakeholders are appropriately engaged with clear roles throughout DAK development

properties.label: Define RASCI matrix
properties.requirement: Can define and maintain a RASCI (Responsible, Accountable, Support, Consulted, Informed) matrix for all DAK activities.

properties.label: Engage guideline stewards
properties.requirement: Can ensure that authors of source documents and subject matter experts are actively engaged in collaborative DAK development.

properties.label: Plan SME consultations
properties.requirement: Can define meeting cadence and format for SME consultations, including workshops, in-person country visits, and online sessions.

properties.label: Prepare consultation materials
properties.requirement: Can create agendas, question lists, and visual aids for SME consultation meetings.

properties.label: Coordinate cross-programme collaboration
properties.requirement: Can identify and coordinate with other health programmes for overlapping components such as shared indicators or data items.

properties.title: Can plan iterations
properties.description: Capability to plan sprint iterations, maintain the DAK backlog, draft the project roadmap, and facilitate retrospectives.
properties.capability: plan sprint iterations, maintain the backlog, and facilitate retrospectives
properties.benefit: DAK development proceeds in focused, time-boxed increments with continuous improvement

properties.label: Maintain DAK backlog
properties.requirement: Can create and maintain a prioritized, estimated backlog of work items, decomposing big items into smaller items accomplishable in days.

properties.label: Plan iteration scope
properties.requirement: Can plan fixed-length iterations (1 month or less) considering team capacity, prior results, and backlog items.

properties.label: Define iteration goals
properties.requirement: Can define iteration goals that create coherence and focus for the team during each sprint.

properties.label: Facilitate retrospectives
properties.requirement: Can facilitate retrospective meetings to assess what went well, identify problems, and improve team effectiveness.

properties.label: Draft project roadmap
properties.requirement: Can draft a project roadmap with estimates for each phase and key milestone dates.

properties.title: Can review terminology
properties.description: Capability to review and validate terminology bindings, code systems, and value sets for correctness and completeness.
properties.capability: review and validate terminology bindings, code systems, and value sets
properties.benefit: terminology artifacts are correct, complete, and consistently applied

properties.label: Review CodeSystem definitions
properties.requirement: Can review FHIR CodeSystem resources for correctness, completeness, and proper hierarchy.

properties.label: Review ValueSet compositions
properties.requirement: Can review FHIR ValueSet resources for correct include/exclude criteria and appropriate expansion.

properties.label: Review terminology bindings
properties.requirement: Can review terminology binding strength (required, extensible, preferred) on profiles and logical models.

properties.label: Identify terminology QA issues
properties.requirement: Can identify unapproved concepts, missing mappings, and duplicate definitions from QA reports.

properties.title: Can map concepts
properties.description: Capability to map data elements to WHO Commons dictionary, ICD-11, SNOMED CT, LOINC, and other standard terminologies.
properties.capability: map data elements to WHO Commons, ICD-11, SNOMED CT, and LOINC
properties.benefit: data elements have standardized semantic references enabling cross-system interoperability

properties.label: Map to WHO Commons dictionary
properties.requirement: Can map every data element to a WHO Commons concept, ensuring the pivotal semantic reference is maintained.

properties.label: Map to ICD-11 and WHO FIC
properties.requirement: Can map concepts to ICD-11 or WHO Family of International Classifications where content exists.

properties.label: Map to SNOMED CT and LOINC
properties.requirement: Can map concepts to SNOMED CT, LOINC, and other openly available reference vocabularies.

properties.label: Onboard new concepts
properties.requirement: Can onboard new concepts into the Commons dictionary, whether from scratch or from existing reference dictionaries.

properties.label: Verify no overlaps or duplicates
properties.requirement: Can verify that new concepts do not duplicate or overlap with existing concepts in the Commons dictionary.

properties.title: Can author code systems
properties.description: Capability to create and maintain FHIR CodeSystem resources.
properties.capability: create and maintain FHIR CodeSystem resources
properties.benefit: terminology is formally defined and versioned as FHIR resources

properties.label: Create CodeSystem resources
properties.requirement: Can create FHIR CodeSystem resources with appropriate properties, hierarchy, and designations.

properties.label: Maintain CodeSystem versioning
properties.requirement: Can manage CodeSystem versioning following SMART Guidelines change tracking policies.

properties.label: Write FSH for CodeSystems
properties.requirement: Can author CodeSystem definitions using FHIR Shorthand (FSH) syntax.

properties.title: Can author value sets
properties.description: Capability to create and maintain FHIR ValueSet resources with appropriate terminology bindings.
properties.capability: create and maintain FHIR ValueSet resources
properties.benefit: value sets are properly defined and conform to executable profiles for implementation

properties.label: Create ValueSet resources
properties.requirement: Can create FHIR ValueSet resources with appropriate include/exclude criteria.

properties.label: Conform to Executable profile
properties.requirement: Can ensure ValueSets conform to the CRMI Executable profile where required.

properties.label: Write FSH for ValueSets
properties.requirement: Can author ValueSet definitions using FHIR Shorthand (FSH) syntax.

properties.title: Can author concept maps
properties.description: Capability to create FHIR ConceptMap resources for cross-terminology mappings.
properties.capability: create FHIR ConceptMap resources for cross-terminology mappings
properties.benefit: cross-terminology relationships are formally defined enabling semantic interoperability

properties.label: Create ConceptMap resources
properties.requirement: Can create FHIR ConceptMap resources defining mappings between source and target code systems.

properties.label: Define equivalence relationships
properties.requirement: Can define appropriate equivalence relationships (equivalent, wider, narrower, etc.) between mapped concepts.

properties.label: Write FSH for ConceptMaps
properties.requirement: Can author ConceptMap definitions using FHIR Shorthand (FSH) syntax.

properties.title: Can translate content
properties.description: Capability to translate IG content across UN languages.
properties.capability: translate IG content across UN languages
properties.benefit: SMART Guidelines are accessible to implementers in all UN languages

properties.label: Translate narrative pages
properties.requirement: Can translate IG narrative page content (markdown/HTML) to target UN languages.

properties.label: Translate resource metadata
properties.requirement: Can translate FHIR resource display names, titles, and descriptions.

properties.label: Manage translation files
properties.requirement: Can manage .pot/.po translation template files and the translation extraction/registration workflow.

properties.label: Coordinate domain terminology
properties.requirement: Can coordinate with clinical SMEs for domain-specific terminology in translations.

properties.title: Can review translations
properties.description: Capability to review translated content for accuracy and completeness.
properties.capability: review translated content for accuracy and completeness
properties.benefit: translations are linguistically accurate and clinically correct across all target languages

properties.label: Review translation accuracy
properties.requirement: Can review translated content for linguistic accuracy and clinical correctness.

properties.label: Verify translation completeness
properties.requirement: Can verify that all translatable content has been translated for each target language.

properties.label: Verify example resource translations
properties.requirement: Can verify that example resources exist for each non-abstract profile in each UN language.
